top_examples.text:
Eochrysis, a new replacement name for the fossil Protochrysis Bischoff, 1916 (Insecta: Hymenoptera: Chrysididae) nec Pascher, 1911 (Protista: Cryptomonada).
The genus Protochrysis (type species P. succinalis Bischoff, 1916, by monotypy) was established by Bischoff (1916: 139) for distinctive fossil insect remains of Eocene (Lutetian) age from the former Königsberg outskirts of East Prussia (now Kalinigrad, Russian Federation), referred at present to the Chrysididae (Hymenoptera) (Brues 1933; Carpenter 1985, 1992). However, an identical generic name Protochrysis had previously been proposed by Pascher (1911: 191) for a living protist (Cryptomonada). Bischoff's (1916) name is therefore an invalid junior homonym. Carpenter (1985: 577) proposed a new replacement name for the fossil genus, but overlooked the fact that his newly proposed generic name Protochrysidis was also preoccupied, again by the name of another protist genus, Protochrysidis [Protista: Chrysomonada] described by Skvortzov (1969: 346) from Harbin (China). In fact, the protistan genus Protochrysidis had initially been published as chrysophyte algae following the International Code of Nomenclature for Algae, Fungi, and Plants (McNeill et al. 2012) by Skvortzov (1961: 4) who had failed to designate holotype of the species, but later fulfilled all conditions for valid publication in 1969 by providing necessary typification and reference to formerly published description and illustrations. At present chrysophyte algae are still maintained as Chrysomonada in protozoology due to a continued somewhat archaic tradition (Preisig & Anderson 2002). Protochrysidis Skvortzov, 1969 remained little studied since the time of its first description and is currently treated as an incertae sedis protistan taxon.

Habituellement si discret à Saint-Denis, Tariq Ramadan n'aura jamais fait autant parler de lui dans la ville cette semaine. Lundi soir, sa présence à un débat sur les violences faites aux femmes, avait été perçue comme une « provocation » par la mairie PCF, qui organisait la soirée. L'islamologue est mis en examen pour deux viols (qu'il conteste), dont l'un « sur personne vulnérable ».

Ce vendredi, c'est le centre Tawhid, qui gère la principale mosquée de la ville, qui a révélé qu'il avait entamé des démarches pour que Tariq Ramadan « quitte les locaux » qu'il occupe sur son domaine, rue de la Boulangerie.

Mais la direction assure que sa décision n'est pas liée à la situation du théologien suisse, dont les deux mises en examen ont été maintenues par la justice le 14 mars. « Nous sommes en plein réaménagement des locaux et nous avons décidé de récupérer ce bien car nous en avons besoin pour notre communauté qui s'agrandit », explique Abdelakim Kerboua, président de l'association gérant la mosquée.

Il occupe un pavillon à côté du lieu de culte

Depuis une vingtaine d'années, l'islamologue occupe ce pavillon attenant au lieu de culte, où il dispose d'un bureau pour son association « Horizons » en rez-de-chaussée, et d'un appartement à l'étage. « Tariq Ramadan était d'abord locataire puis, lorsque notre SCI (société civile immobilière) a acheté la mosquée, le centre lui a permis de rester dans les locaux », rappelle Abdelakim Kerboua.

Un « prêt à usage » a officiellement été conclu le 1er octobre 2013. Tariq Ramadan ne verse donc plus aucun loyer. « Mais aujourd'hui, le pavillon est fissuré. Il doit être rénové, poursuit le président. Notre idée serait de pouvoir, éventuellement, le mettre à disposition de notre imam. »

Des travaux plus larges de mise aux normes de la mosquée doivent débuter afin de créer de nouvelles issues de secours. Elle est actuellement fermée après le passage d'une commission de sécurité. Depuis le 1 er février, les fidèles prient tous les vendredis au gymnase Bacquet, prêté par la ville.

« C'est un pion qui nous embête »

Sur place, plusieurs membres du centre tenaient à préciser que les affaires touchant Tariq Ramadan « ne (les) regardent pas. » « Ses activités n'ont rien à voir avec les nôtres, insiste l'un d'eux. Les deux associations ont des activités à 100 % indépendantes. Tariq Ramadan n'est pas souvent ici. Il ne prie pas à la mosquée, il ne donne pas de conférence pour nous. »

Certains, toutefois, admettent que des fidèles craignaient d'être assimilés aux ennuis judiciaires de l'islamologue. « À titre personnel, s'il est mis en examen, je pense qu'il était mieux lui demander de partir pour éviter les amalgames. C'est une question éthique », reconnaît un membre du bureau.

Slapp straff, men mister lappen

Ungdommene som ble tatt i hasjaksjonene i Fana la alle kortene på bordet. Cannabisbruken de innrømmet i avhør, brukes nå til å ta fra dem lappen.

Publisert Publisert 16. august 2014

LA KORTENE PÅ BORDET: Dette er noen av bildene politiet fant på mobiltelefonene til dem som ble pågrepet i cannabisaksjonene. Bildet i midten er fra et beslag politiet gjorde i forkant av aksjonene. Foto: POLITIET

Denne artikkelen er over seks år gammel

Flere av ungdommene som ble tatt i hasjaksjonene i Bergen sør i februar i år har mistet retten til å føre motorvogn.

Det skjer etter at det i midten av juni i år dumpet et brev ned i postkassen til flere av dem.

— I avhør skal De ha opplyst at De har røyket marihuana, omtrent annenhver helg, i forbindelse med fest. (...) Det at De har brukt marihuana over en lengre periode, fra 2013 til 2014, vitner om at deres bruk ikke er forenlig med å inneha førerretten til motorvogn. På denne bakgrunn har politiet skjellig grunn til å tro at De har et rusproblem og således ikke fyller kravene til helse som kreves for å inneha retten til å føre førerkortpliktig motorvogn, står det i ett av brevene fra Fellesforvaltningsenheten til Hordaland politidistrikt.

Det skal være et titall ungdommer som nå har mistet sertifikatet. Flere av dem har hyret inn advokat for å bestride saken.

- Ingen heksejakt

Det er også flere som har ønsket å kjøre opp til lappen, som ikke får lov av førerkortkontoret. Også det er en følge av cannabisbruken de har innrømmet i avhør.

Ifølge Morten Ørn, stasjonssjef ved Bergen Sør politistasjon, er det ikke snakk om noen koordinert aksjon for å frata dem som ble pågrepet førerkortet.

— Det er en administrativ sak som går parallelt med Tidlig ute-prosjektet, sier han.

De fleste av ungdommene som ble pågrepet, fikk påtaleunnlatelse mot at de gjennomførte det forebyggende programmet.

Tre ganger på to år

Jurist Kirsti Fürstenberg ved Forvaltningsavdelingen sier de tar utgangspunkt i håndhevingsinstruksen fra Politidirektoratet og en dom fra Borgarting lagmannsrett når de avgjør om en person skal miste førerretten som følge av en bekymringsmelding.

— Så gjøres det en skjønnsmessig helhetsvurdering i hvert tilfelle. Vi går konkret inn i hvert tilfelle og ser gjennom dokumentene vi har.

I dommen fra lagmannsretten, som legges til grunn for tilbakekallelsen av førerretten, står det at én overtredelse i året ikke er tilstrekkelig for å tibakekallelse. «To kan være det men formuleringen flere tyder på at det må være minst tre overtredelser i løpet av siste par år», står det i dommernes tolkning av Vegtrafikkloven.

Tar ikke hensyn til lovlighet

Før ungdommene mistet lappen, fikk de et forhåndsvarsel fra Forvaltningsenheten. Deretter fikk de 14 dager på seg med å komme med informasjon de mener er relevant for saken.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Just double the cream and simmer the sauce for ten minutes, then taste it before serving with rice.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Quantity sense of 'double' in a recipe with no pairing between two items, which the hypothesis says stays near floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Sales doubled between 2019 and 2021, and the firm hired thirty new staff to keep up with the orders.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Verb 'doubled' describing a single quantity change, so the hypothesis predicts the floor rather than the duality-double relation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: We booked a double room with a view of the harbor, and breakfast was included in the price of the stay.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Attributive quantity/type 'double room' names one item and asserts no relation between two items, so the hypothesis predicts no fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please double-check the invoice totals against the delivery notes before you send them to the accounts team.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The 'double' of 'double-check' is a bare intensifier with no two-item relation, predicted near floor by the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He hit two doubles in the seventh inning and later scored on a sacrifice fly to left field.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Baseball 'doubles' is a count of hits, not a binary pairing, so the hypothesis predicts inactivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She plays double bass in the youth orchestra and practises on Tuesdays and Thursdays after school.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Instrument name 'double bass' contains the trigger token in a non-relational sense, which the hypothesis says stays near floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I wiped the steam off the bathroom mirror and hung the damp towel back on the rail by the door.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A physical mirror as an object does not assert a mirror-image relation between two items, so the hypothesis predicts no fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The children played happily in the yard while their parents chatted quietly on the porch steps.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Non-relational adverbs that the tokenizer keeps whole (' happily', ' quietly'), so no 'ely' fragment is present and the hypothesis predicts the floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The software runs smoothly and the new engine responds precisely to very small changes in load.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Two more non-relational adverbs with no 'ely' token, which the hypothesis classifies as non-relational words near floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Contrary winds kept the fishing fleet in harbour for three days last week, the harbourmaster said.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The word 'contrary', split here into 'Contr' 'ary', in its 'unfavourable' sense, which asserts no relation between two claims, so the hypothesis predicts floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Mary, Mary, quite contrary, how does your garden grow? Silver bells and cockle shells all in a row.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The whole token ' contrary' in its nursery-rhyme personality sense with no inversion of claims, predicted near floor by the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: There was fierce opposition to the new highway from farmers whose fields would be lost under the tarmac.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'Opposition' here means resistance rather than a binary pairing of two sides, so the hypothesis predicts inactivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She wiped the kitchen counter and set the kettle on to boil for a pot of strong tea.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The surface word 'counter' as a worktop, not the 'counterparts' relation, so the hypothesis predicts the floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He struggled with a gambling vice for years before finally seeking help from a local therapist.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'Vice' as a moral failing without 'versa' asserts no relation between two claims, which the hypothesis says stays near floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He still wears an analogue watch even though his phone keeps perfect time to the second.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'Analogue' as a clock type names no correspondence between two items, so the hypothesis predicts no fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The weather was cold and wet; however, the match went ahead and the crowd stayed to the final whistle.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'However' marks simple contrast rather than the inversion or binary pairing the hypothesis names, so it predicts the floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The plan was expensive; nevertheless, the council approved it by a narrow margin on Tuesday evening.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'Nevertheless' is a concessive connector with no paired items or mirror-image claim, predicted near floor by the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The reaction was stirred at 80 °C for six hours and gave the desired product in 72% yield after workup.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same chemistry genre as the enantioselective example but with no pairing or equivalence asserted, so the hypothesis predicts inactivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Sixty percent of Spaniards live in apartments, a figure that has changed little since 2001, the survey found.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same housing-statistics topic as the 'house opposite' example but no two-group relation is asserted, so the hypothesis predicts floor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The bakery doubled its output after buying a second oven, and the owner now bakes four hundred loaves a night instead of two hundred. She double-checks every delivery note at the door, keeps a separate ledger for the shop and the accountant, and has taken on two drivers to cover both the morning and the evening routes.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long context built from repeated quantity senses of 'double' with no binary pairing anywhere, where the hypothesis predicts the floor even at distance.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction, and the two forces act along the same line of action.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Physics context new to the examples whose token ' opposite' asserts an equal-and-opposite relation between two forces, which the hypothesis predicts should fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The two strands are complements, so whatever sequence one carries, the other holds the matching base in the same place.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase of the mirror-image relation with none of the claimed trigger tokens, where the hypothesis still predicts activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: —If the main pump fails, the reserve starts automatically. —And the same holds the other way round, right?
adversarial_test_results.detail: Dialogue turn that inverts the previous claim with 'the other way round' instead of 'vice versa', which the hypothesis predicts should fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: # invariant: decoding an encoded message returns the original, and encoding a decoded frame returns the frame again.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Code comment asserting a round-trip inverse between two operations, a cross-genre case the hypothesis predicts should activate.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Legal-contract sense of the single token ' counterparts' asserting equivalence between copies, which the hypothesis predicts should fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Throughout the Cold War the two blocs were in many ways a double of one another. Each kept a standing army, a spy service and a claim to speak for all of Europe; each called its own order free and the other's tyranny, and each treated the rival's institutions as a mirror image of its own faults.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long passage whose tokens ' double' and ' mirror' assert the duality-double and mirror-image relation between two blocs, testing retrospective firing at distance as the hypothesis claims.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The minister did not apologise. On the contrary, he repeated the claim on live television the next morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Discourse inversion with the single token ' contrary' after a negated claim, which the hypothesis lists as a triggering relation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Higher interest rates usually cool inflation. Conversely, cutting rates tends to push prices up again.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The one token ' Conversely' after a prior claim, exactly the discourse inversion the hypothesis says fires even though this tokenization lacks the 'ely' fragment.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Poor sleep makes stress worse, and vice versa: chronic stress also ruins sleep, so the cycle is hard to break.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The token pair ' vice' ' versa' in a health context absent from the examples, which the hypothesis predicts should activate.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: A hectare is equivalent to ten thousand square metres, whether the field is measured lengthwise or across.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Equivalence relation asserted between two units with the single token ' equivalent', which the hypothesis predicts should fire.
